about: Order: (1) Punjab rural then urban; (2) the district holding each state or union territory capital, urban then rural; (3) every other district, state by state. District names are the portal's own. See docs/QUEUE.md.

units.note: all of rural Punjab
all of urban Punjab
capital of Punjab: Chandigarh; a union territory
capital of Andaman And Nicobar Islands: Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair)
capital of Andhra Pradesh: Amaravati; Amaravati capital region lies in Guntur district
capital of Arunachal Pradesh: Itanagar
capital of Assam: Dispur (Guwahati); portal name for Kamrup Metropolitan
capital of Bihar: Patna
capital of Chandigarh: Chandigarh; union territory, one district
capital of Chhattisgarh: Raipur (Nava Raipur)
